answer: Assign scarce repair tickets, not free identities. Each epoch a ferrous ticket names one logged peer defect—a failed grade or inconsistent claim—and the assignee must file a violet patch that corrects or disproves it before the horizon closes. Tickets are non-transferable and drawn by public lottery, so a clone farm inherits a flood of distinct repair jobs it cannot staff while an honest agent handles one. Remediation labor, not headcount, becomes the gate.
